in_marathi.name: Dheemsansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Think, Ponder, Reflect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheemsansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dheemsansh is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words: 'Dheem' meaning 'to think' and 'Sansh' meaning 'reflection' or 'ponder'. This name symbolizes the importance of introspection and deep thought in one's life.
